rounds.text: Hence to fight and conquer in all your battles is not supreme excellence; supreme excellence consists in breaking the enemy's resistance without fighting.
rounds.label: Sun Tzu

rounds.text: So take a look what you've done / 'Cause, baby, now we got bad blood, hey
rounds.label: Taylor

rounds.text: All warfare is based on deception.
rounds.label: Sun Tzu

rounds.text: I thought instead, I'd replace myself first with a new me. It's harder to hit a moving target.
rounds.label: Taylor

rounds.text: Anger may in time change to gladness; vexation may be succeeded by content.
rounds.label: Sun Tzu
rounds.note: Sun Tzu, Art of War, XII.20

rounds.text: Trash takes itself out every single time.
rounds.label: Taylor

rounds.text: Ponder and deliberate before you make a move.
rounds.label: Sun Tzu
rounds.note: Sun Tzu, Art of War, VII.21

rounds.text: People would act like it was a weapon I was using. Like a cheap dirty trick.
rounds.label: Taylor

rounds.text: Attack him where he is unprepared, appear where you are not expected.
rounds.label: Sun Tzu
rounds.note: Sun Tzu, Art of War, I.24

rounds.text: Heaven signifies night and day, cold and heat, times and seasons.
rounds.label: Sun Tzu
rounds.note: Sun Tzu, Art of War, I.7

traps.text: If my ex leaves a door open, you must rush in.
traps.label: Sun Tzu (two words swapped)
traps.note: XI.65 is 'If the enemy leaves a door open, you must rush in.' We swapped 'the enemy' for 'my ex'.

traps.text: girl, let your plans be dark and impenetrable as night, and when you move, fall like a thunderbolt.
traps.label: Sun Tzu (one word added)
traps.note: VII.19 word for word, plus 'girl,' at the start.

traps.text: Hold out baits to entice my ex. Feign disorder, and crush him.
traps.label: Sun Tzu (two words swapped)
traps.note: I.20 is 'Hold out baits to entice the enemy. Feign disorder, and crush him.' We swapped 'the enemy' for 'my ex'.

traps.text: But I've also learned there's no point in actively trying to quote unquote defeat your enemies
traps.label: Taylor
